body: From the DM-190 final review (orchestrator, this run): the UI must surface `failure.retryable`, the withdraw `verified` flag (warn and require confirmation when unverified), and these remaining states: (1) link failed, target epic later deleted, experiment closed -> retry target_missing, withdraw refused ('retry it', src/main/desktop/crossRepoCorrections.ts:270), recreate refused ('withdraw it', src/core/services/crossRepoCorrections.ts:707) — fix: let withdraw through when the receipt names an epic the readable checkout verifiably does not hold; (2) a lost receipt cannot be relinked once the experiment is closed (refused before reading the target, :350) — allow linking an epic the target already holds. Fix both here since you build the flow.
